Prototype · proposed 30-hour core.

Each chapter estimates three hours of total noncoding study, including setup, practice and assessment. Learner timings and effectiveness have not been validated. Optional Python activities add the time shown in their workspace; they do not silently replace core study. This is formative learning with self-reviewed reasoning, not an accredited credential or secure examination.

Set up your self-learning route

Bring basic arithmetic, percentages, paper and a calculator. Core chapters need no installation or financial account. Each chapter has a complete text/paper route and downloadable data where relevant. The Python setup guide offers real browser Python or standard-library scripts for local practice.

Progress is saved separately on this browser for each chapter and Python practice. Exports are local learning records, not cross-device sync or restore. Use supplied classroom data and export before changing devices. A hosting provider may retain access logs; optional Python downloads its runtime from jsDelivr on first run.

All examples are original hypothetical teaching data. Prototype backtests and simulations do not demonstrate investability or forecast actual outcomes. Research-plan locks teach sequencing; downloadable source and browser storage remain accessible. Full assistive-technology testing, target-learner pilots and commercial release checks remain pending.
